subject: VALUE clause
notes: RE-VERDICTED 2026-09-28 (kb/Work PB1716) -- SAME VERDICT, THE FILL IS NOW BOUNDED BY THE PHRASE. TableValueOdometer.ElementCount computes the number of consecutive table elements a phrase names (the mixed-radix distance from subscript-1 to subscript-2 in this rule's odometer order) before the fill, and Resolve fills exactly that many; the 64,000,000-element cap that was the only bound is gone. A unit test proves the count equals the odometer walk over every tuple pair of a 2x3x2 table. RE-VERDICTED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB505) -- THE FILL IS NOW THE ODOMETER GR12 DESCRIBES, ON ALL THREE STORAGE LANES. The map this row was recorded against was keyed by ONE occurrence number, which can only express a one-dimensional table on its own OCCURS entry; GR12's second half -- "Consecutive table elements are referenced by incrementing by 1 the subscript that represents the least inclusive dimension of the table. When any reference to a subscript, prior to incrementing it, is equal to the maximum number of occurrences ... that subscript is set to 1 and the subscript for the next most inclusive dimension of the table is incremented by 1" -- had no expression at all, and its whole population was refused by a staged COBOL0899. It is now TableValueOdometer.Step, over a dimension list built root-downward from the entry's OCCURS ancestors, resolved ONCE in the binder into a subscript-tuple -> literal map on the entry. DataItem.ValueAt is THE reader and every lane takes it, each threading an OCCURRENCE CONTEXT down the record: the record-struct fields (ValueInitializer.FieldInit), the character-image backings (GroupImageCodec.ImageInitOf) and the packed BOOLEAN POSITIONS of a bit group (GroupImageCodec.InitialBitCarrierOf). THE BIT CARRIER WAS A THIRD LANE WITH THE SAME DEFECT kb/Work PB208 fixed on the second: it read m.RawValue -- null for a table VALUE -- and StrRepeat'd one occurrence, so `01 BG GROUP-USAGE BIT. 05 B PIC 1(4) OCCURS 3 VALUES ARE B"1010" B"0101" FROM (1). 01 BV REDEFINES BG PIC X(2).` came back [0000|0000|0000] where the SAME declaration without the alias gave [1010|0101|1010] (MEASURED on this tree before the fix). MEASURED after: six literals FROM (1 1) TO (2 3) on a 2x3 table give [123|456]; the bit table gives [1010|0101|1010] on both spellings; AllStorageLanes_SeedTheSameOccurrences compiles five shapes twice -- once natively, once behind a REDEFINES alias that moves them onto their image lane -- and requires the same answer, so a shape wired into one lane only reds there. kb/Work PB1722 (w1042a): the plan is its well-formed PHRASES (TableValueOdometer.Resolve), never an element map. LiteralAt scans the phrases last to first (GR15) and takes the literal at the element's run position modulo the list (GR13); the emitters compose one element per run of occurrences that initialize alike (TableValueRuns.Of, OccurrenceRunEmit), and INITIALIZE ... TO VALUE tests one rank range per phrase residue (TableValuePlan.RankForm, CobolTable.InSpan). The 10000 x 10000 filed table compiles in 1.7 s / 223 MB / 3.6 KB of C#.
